title: The Migration of Dan

questions.question: Which tribe was seeking an inheritance because they hadn't received theirs yet?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:1 (ESV): "...In those days the tribe of the people of Dan was seeking for itself an inheritance to dwell in..."

questions.question: How many spies did the Danites send?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:2 (ESV): "So the people of Dan sent five able men from the whole number of their tribe..."

questions.question: Who did the spies recognize at Micah's house?
options: The voice of the young Levite
questions.correctAnswer: The voice of the young Levite
questions.explanation: Judges 18:3 (ESV): "When they were by the house of Micah, they recognized the voice of the young Levite..."

questions.question: What city did the spies find unsuspecting and secure?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:7 (ESV): "Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in security..."

questions.question: What did the Danites take from Micah?
options: The carved image, the ephod, the household gods, and the metal image
questions.correctAnswer: The carved image, the ephod, the household gods, and the metal image
questions.explanation: Judges 18:18 (ESV): "...went into Micah's house and took the carved image, the ephod, the household gods, and the metal image..."

questions.question: What offer did the Danites make to the Levite priest?
options: Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and clan in Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and clan in Israel?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:19 (ESV): "...Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and clan in Israel?"

questions.question: How did Micah react when he realized his gods were gone?
options: He gathered men and pursued the Danites
questions.correctAnswer: He gathered men and pursued the Danites
questions.explanation: Judges 18:22 (ESV): "...the men who were in the houses near Micah's house were called out, and they overtook the people of Dan."

questions.question: Why did Micah turn back from pursuing the Danites?
options: He saw that they were too strong for him
questions.correctAnswer: He saw that they were too strong for him
questions.explanation: Judges 18:26 (ESV): "...And when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his home."

questions.question: What did the Danites rename Laish?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:29 (ESV): "And they named the city Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor..."

questions.question: How many armed men of Dan went on this expedition?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:11 (ESV): "...600 men of the tribe of Dan, armed with weapons of war."

questions.question: Who was the young Levite priest identified as (Jonathan son of...)?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:30 (ESV): "And Jonathan the son of Gershom, son of Moses..."

questions.question: How long did the Danites keep the idol?
options: Until the day of the captivity of the land
questions.correctAnswer: Until the day of the captivity of the land
questions.explanation: Judges 18:30 (ESV): "...until the day of the captivity of the land."

questions.question: Where was the house of God located while the idol was in Dan?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:31 (ESV): "So they set up Micah's carved image... all the time that the house of God was at Shiloh."

questions.question: The people of Laish lived after the manner of the ____?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:7 (ESV): "...after the manner of the Sidonians, quiet and unsuspecting..."

questions.question: Why "Mahaneh-dan"?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:12 (ESV): "...therefore that place is called Mahaneh-dan to this day..."

key_verse_text: So they set up Micah’s carved image that he made, as long as the house of God was at Shiloh. (ESV)
